title: Five cheapest base fares
statementMd:
The five lowest base prices among flights, cheapest first. Break ties by flight id.

Expected columns: `id`, `base_price`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, base_price FROM flights ORDER BY base_price, id LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
